## LDraw assets and derived views

LEGO part geometry is loaded from the official LDraw library through the selected Brickwright checkout. Stock meshes retain the authorship and license in their source headers and the selected LDraw lock. Consult the preview provenance and notices for the files actually consumed by this model. Where a source declares CC BY 4.0, that attribution license remains applicable to the asset and its derived rendered representation. Standard stock meshes can remain external; an `.ldr` model is a set of placements, not a redistribution of the entire LDraw library.

The independent assembly and its documentation are BSD-3-Clause. No right is asserted to relicense LDraw geometry, MPL files or any other third-party work as BSD.

The eight selected color labels and values in `dependencies/part-and-color-names.json` derive from LDraw.org's `LDConfig.ldr`. They retain [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Display names replace the source underscores with spaces; source identity and hash are retained in the snapshot.

Brickwright Lite's own application code is BSD-3-Clause; its complete dependency inventory is documented by the project's `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` at the selected revision.
